idea: Uniform formulas for X,Y in SL(2,q) from powers of t=g^k, Dickson traces, Legendre sign (15 variants, c11/gen_c11.py). Best D6 = V7: X=[[2,t],[1,(1+t)/2]], Y=[[1/t,2],[1/t,t+2]] (mean 3.131 vs random 3.359). Best D8 = V3: {I,w} + X=[[t,t^3],[t^h,(t^(3+h)+1)/t]], Y=[[t^2,1],[1/t,(1+1/t)/t^2]], h=(q+1)/2 (mean 3.163 vs random 3.329). Overall best Delta 6.

idea: Torus-orbit Haar families S={I} u union of T-conjugates of a generic x (T split or nonsplit torus of PSL(2,q)), Delta ~ q (2 orbits) or ~3q/2 (3 orbits); diam per q=31,37,41,43,47,53,59,61: 1 orbit 6-7; 2 orbits split [5,6,6,5,6,6,6,6], nonsplit 5-6; 3 orbits 5 for all q; no diam<=4 (flag: none, diam 4 impossible by counting for one orbit); score = best |G|/W(Delta,diam) at q=31 (split, 2 orbits, seed 3, Delta=31, diam 5)
